name: images_restyle
description: Re-renders an image in another LOOK while keeping its subject, layout and proportions. Give exactly one style source: `colors` (a palette), `styleCreationIdentifier` (an image whose style to copy) or `styleId` (a library style from `library_list` type=style). Content changes are `images_generate` with a reference; lighting only is `images_relight`. Then `creations_show`.

colors.description: Palette to recolour with. Max 6 colours.

weight.description: 0.05..1 share of the palette. Defaults to an even split.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

model.description: Restyle model slug. Default restyle-auto, which picks for you; omit it unless the user named a model. A slug that is not available to the caller is refused with the ones that are.

styleCreationIdentifier.description: Image creation whose artistic style to copy onto the source.

styleId.description: Numeric `id` of a library style (`library_list` with type=style).
